contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Hair Transplant & PRP Therapy in Ghaziabad

Restore density naturally with FUE, GFC, PRP, QR678, Mesotherapy & growth-factor therapies.

Overview

Our hair-restoration suite combines minimally-invasive FUE hair transplant, PRP/GFC, QR67, Mesotherapy, growth-factor injections, and clinically-proven medical therapy.

The result: a denser, natural-looking hairline that lasts a lifetime.

Key benefits

  • Permanent, natural-looking results
  • Painless FUE — no stitches, no scars
  • PRP boosts existing hair density
  • Single-day procedure
  • Performed by trained surgical team

Who should opt

  • Men & women with stable pattern hair-loss
  • Receding hairlines or thinning crown
  • Patients seeking density without medication
BEFORE & AFTER

Real results from real patients

View documented transformations from our hair transplant & prp patients.
